title: Leftover Pancake Breakfast Sandwich
description: Ham, cheese, and a fried egg are sandwiched between two buttermilk pancakes and covered with syrup. A great way to use up leftover pancakes!

steps.text: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and lightly spray with cooking spray. Crack egg into the pan and break the yolk. Cook egg to desired firmness. Warm sliced ham in the pan alongside the egg.
Meanwhile, toast pancakes in the toaster.

Assemble the sandwich: Place one toasted pancake on a plate. Top with cooked egg, 1/2 of the maple syrup, Cheddar cheese, warmed ham slice, and remaining pancake. Drizzle remaining maple syrup over top.

video.description: Don’t throw away those leftover buttermilk pancakes—they can be transformed into an incredibly tasty and satisfying breakfast sandwich! First make a frambled—a cross between a fried and scrambled egg—by cracking an egg into your skillet and breaking the yolk. Cook until firm and warm ham in the pan. Toast two pancakes in the toaster, then place one of them onto a plate. Top with the egg, maple syrup, Cheddar cheese and ham. Finish the sandwich by covering with the other pancake and another pouring of maple syrup. Sweet and savory breakfast food is tasty any time!
video.name: Leftover Pancake Breakfast Sandwich
